deviations_from_card: One commit, not three: the ADR and changelog went in under the lock in a single green commit, as the brief allows. Guard case 5 was red before too, but only because pick_bench did not exist yet (a collection ImportError); it compares pick_bench with today's pick_all on a full, current, all-clear grid. Guard 6 (tiers.json untouched, complete=True) was green before. In guard 5, config, fallback and disqualified match exactly; why starts with today's text and adds '; paired n of N, speed over ...' (case 3 requires that suffix). Legacy records with no bench_digest count as stale in make_plan too, not only in load_results; otherwise they would be skipped by the plan and left out of the pick for good. So test_run's resume fixtures now carry the current digest. Each record is stamped with its own scenario's digest (cell_digest = bench_digest([scenario])), so a --scenarios subset run stamps the same value as a full run. report.md shows the full-set digest. When the file exists, the digest uses scenario file bytes from SCENARIOS_DIR; otherwise it uses canonical JSON of the scenario. pick_role and pick_all keep their signatures; __main__ now calls the new pick_bench. load_results returns a Results dataclass (interviews, shapes, stale, digest) instead of a 2-tuple; its only caller, __main__, is updated.
notes: ADR 0145 claimed under the lock. No sibling reds seen: whole-tree ruff, format and mypy were green. chores_uat imports simulate and was run, green. Slot B (incumbent diff, --accept-fallback) will touch the same pick.py, report.py and __main__.py. Pick now has cells, paired, conditioned, speed and pooled fields, and __main__ calls pick_bench rather than pick_all.
